content.value: The content model is Barkpark's single source of truth — typed documents, the schemas that shape them, and the containers that scope them.

A Document is the atom of content. Its shape is a Schema — a named set of typed fields. Schema v2 is the current field-type system, adding richer types including the Reference Field that lets one document point at another and thereby seeds the Content Graph.
A document's body can carry structured rich text as a PortableDoc, the block format that pdrender paints and that Bulldocs ingests.

), which is grouped under a Project, which belongs to a Workspace. A Perspective is a read lens over a dataset — for example draft-vs-published — letting a Mutation stage changes without disturbing what consumers see.

Surfaces never assume the model. They learn every schema, dataset, and field type from the Capabilities Manifest returned by the Phoenix API, which is exactly what makes the bp CLI and Go TUI self-configuring. When a Document is written through a Mutation, its Reference Field values flow straight into the Edge Extractor and onto the graph.
